source_text: Refraining from neonatal circumcision substantially reduces the risk, as the condition is rare in uncircumcised males and occurs in approximately 5-10% of circumcised boys, often due to post-procedural meatal exposure to urine-soaked diapers and resultant chemical irritation. [6]
